content: Figure 3 shows the relation categories for which Dolores performed the best and the worst relative to baseline TransE embeddings in terms of mean rank (lower is better). In particular, Figure 3 shows the categories where Dolores performs the best and reveals categories like food, user, olympics, organization. Note for example, that for triples belonging under the food relation, Dolores outperforms baseline by TransE by a factor of 4 in terms of mean rank.
